title: Grogu
subtitle: Mysterious Child
text:
Hidden
Action [Exhaust]: Heal up to 2 damage from a unit. If you do, deal that much damage to a unit.
rules:
Grogu's ability can still be used as an action even if you don't or can't heal damage from a unit (but you don't deal any damage to a unit).
If a unit has Hidden and Sentinel at the same time, it can be attacked.
